title: قرارداد داده و روز مرجع
acceptanceCriteria: قرارداد نسخه‌دار شامل منبع هر فیلد، قواعد null/zero، شیفت، مدت، نفرساعت، ترتیب بخش‌ها و تصمیم‌های C01 تا C08 ثبت و تأیید شود.
defects: DEF-B01-01: Missing report_number and project_day_number in DailyReport data model
DEF-B01-02: Work shift actual duration missing, outputting hardcoded 'ساعات کاری شیفت: ثبت نشده' in export
DEF-B01-03: Headcount sum erroneously labeled as 'نفرروز' without unique worker presence proof
DEF-B01-04: Rigid hardcoded 34/32 catalog in export without configurable project profile mapping
DEF-B01-05: Missing integration of wind and ground conditions from WeatherLog to official daily header
DEF-B01-06: Unresolved and unratified scope decisions C01 to C08 causing data contract ambiguity

verificationDetails.sectionsCovered: 18 broader daily sections audited against apps/api/core/field_reports/ and export templates
verificationDetails.scopeDecisions: C01 to C08 unratified or partially implemented
verificationDetails.nullZeroRules: Discrepancy between historical validation logic (rejecting 0) and updated requirement (valid measured 0 vs null unset)
verificationDetails.shiftDuration: Mismatch between header shift definitions and row-level shifts; missing duration field in hours
verificationDetails.manHours: Headcount sum treated as man-days without deduplicated identity attendance tracking

summary: Requirement B01 (Data Contract & Reference Day Test Sample Closure) verification failed due to open scope decisions C01-C08, missing fields in daily report header (report number, project day, shift duration), unmapped weather attributes, and lack of a finalized versioned data contract across all 18 broader daily sections.
